create.name: Jhaimy Alvarez Acosta
create.bio:
Jhaimy Alvarez Acosta is a traditional Andean curandero and wisdom keeper who was born and raised in the Andes around Cusco, Peru. He began training with his Elders as a boy and has followed that path for more than three decades, and was initiated into the Apu Wachumita line and into mesa practice as it is kept in both northern and south-eastern Peru. He also holds a master's degree in tourism from the Universidad Andina del Cusco and has spent around twenty-five years leading spiritual journeys to the temples and sacred sites of the Andes.

In 2006 he and Starr Muranko founded Children of the Seven Rays, a community now based in North Vancouver that shares Andean teachings online and in person. Its programmes start with a self-paced course in foundational Andean teachings, covering the Andean view of the cosmos, the balance of complementary energies and the four elements, and lead on to a year-long Mesa Path in which each student builds a personal mesa, the sacred bundle at the heart of the tradition. Members of the Yachay Wasi community meet with him monthly for live teaching. He also leads small-group journeys to Peru, including a ten-day equinox pilgrimage offered through Hollyhock, and hosts the Heart of the Condor podcast.

courses.title: Peru Equinox Retreat: A Journey into Balance, Renewal, and Creation
courses.description: A ten-day small-group journey in Peru, run with Hollyhock, that visits six ancient temples around Cusco, the Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu at the March equinox. Jhaimy teaches at each site and leads a traditional despacho offering and a sound ceremony along the way.
courses.price: $5,800 USD ($8,250 CAD) per person, double occupancy; single rooms $600 USD extra; flights not included

courses.title: Foundational Andean Teachings
courses.description: A self-paced online introduction to the Andean spiritual path, with twelve weeks of access to the course portal. It covers the Andean cosmovision, harmonising mind, body and soul, the four elements and the history of the mesa, and is the starting point for the longer programmes.

courses.title: The Mesa Path
courses.description: A twelve-month online programme, by application, in which a small cohort works through eleven modules with Jhaimy and builds a personal mesa bundle. It ends with a completion ceremony, held in person or at a distance, and a welcome into the wider community.

courses.title: Yachay Wasi Membership
courses.description: An online membership with a monthly live teaching circle led by Jhaimy, weekly reflection prompts, guided meditations and seasonal events with guest teachers. New members start with a four-month bundle that includes a one-to-one session with him.

free_resources.title: Free Guided Meditation
free_resources.description: A free fifteen-minute guided meditation from Jhaimy, sent by email when you join the community newsletter. It is a short Andean practice for feeling grounded, calm and centred.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @childrenofthe7rays 132 subscribers (channel header, 4 Nov 2026) is the organisation's shared channel, so not counted; Instagram and Facebook are also organisation accounts and were not opened (blocked hosts); no personal accounts found → 0 readable personal followers → local_hero
flags: Listed as Jhaimy himself (the teacher in every offering) rather than as Children of the Seven Rays; the organisation was co-founded with Starr Muranko, who is mentioned in the bio. The YouTube link is the organisation's channel, on which he is the main speaker.

Base: the lead said Cusco, but the organisation's About page says 'We are based in North Vancouver, Canada' and that Jhaimy returns to Peru through the year; Cusco is where he was born. North Vancouver recorded as the base; not a regional gap.

Plant medicine checked: his bio cites the Apu Wachumita (Huachuma/San Pedro) lineage, but none of the offerings listed (Hollyhock Peru itinerary and tour page, Foundational course, Mesa Path, membership) advertise plant-medicine ceremonies; the Hollyhock trip lists a despacho and sound ceremony. The lineage is mentioned in the bio only as a lineage name.
Email info@childrenofthe7rays.com is the organisation's general inbox.
Only one photo (Hollyhock presenter photo). The organisation's own images are on kajabi-cdn.com, whose robots.txt returned 403, so they were not fetched.
The Mesa Path's next cohort 'begins January 2027' with no exact date, so it is listed undated.
One video comes from a 2023 Shift Network summit (posted on his own channel); his current Shift Network status was not checked (theshiftnetwork.com refuses us).
Free meditation is delivered by email after a newsletter sign-up; its page title calls it a 'Guided Meditation for Healing and Balance' (no condition named).
left_out: Pilgrimage to Northern Peru (22 Oct - 3 Nov 2026): already started and registration closed.
Promotional and testimonial clips under two minutes (Mesa trailers, Munay, tour promos) and a school-visit clip.
Heart of the Condor podcast: no podcast page found on his site to link.
Personal mentorship sessions: only offered inside the membership bundle.
